name: What are the benefits of a detached garage versus an attached garage?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a detached garage versus an attached garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached garage offers several distinct benefits compared to an attached one. It provides greater separation for noise and odors from vehicles or workshops, enhanced fire safety for the main home, and more flexibility in placement on your property. Detached garages also often allow for easier future expansion or conversion into other uses, such as a studio or ADU, without impacting the main house structure. This separation can also improve the aesthetic appeal of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Detached garages offer noise and odor separation, enhanced fire safety, flexible placement, and easier future conversion options compared to attached garages.
